items.source:
This can be used to register custom beans without inferring
annotation-based characteristics for primary/fallback/lazy-init,
rather specifying those programmatically if needed.
items.translation: 这可用于注册自定义 Bean，而无需推断基于注解的主/备用/懒加载特性；如有需要，可程序化地指定这些特性。

items.source: Common interface for annotation config application contexts, defining register(BeanRegistrar...) and scan(String...) methods.
items.translation: 用于注解配置应用上下文的通用接口，定义了register(BeanRegistrar...)和scan(String...)方法。

items.source: Perform a scan within the specified base packages.
items.translation: 在指定的基础包内执行扫描。

items.source: registrars - one or more BeanRegistrar instances
items.translation: registrars - 一个或多个BeanRegistrar实例

items.source: Calls to register are idempotent; adding the same component class more than once has no additional effect.
items.translation: 对 `register` 的调用是幂等的；多次添加相同的组件类不会产生额外效果。

items.source:
Register one or more component classes to be processed, inferring
annotation-based characteristics for primary/fallback/lazy-init
just like for scanned component classes.
items.translation: 注册一个或多个组件类以供处理，推断基于注解的主/备用/懒加载特性，就像对扫描的组件类一样。

items.source:
Invoke the given registrars for registering their beans with this
application context.
items.translation: 调用给定的注册器，将它们的 Bean 注册到此应用程序上下文中。

items.source: componentClasses - one or more component classes, for example, @Configuration classes
items.translation: componentClasses - 一个或多个组件类，例如，@Configuration 类

items.source: basePackages - the packages to scan for component classes
